summary: Vermilion Energy Inc. filed Form 6-K announcing TSX approval to renew its normal course issuer bid (NCIB) to repurchase up to 15,157,179 common shares (~10% of public float) from July 12, 2026 to July 11, 2027. Purchases are subject to daily volume limits (25% of 6-month average trading volume), with block purchase exceptions. Repurchased shares will be cancelled. The company will enter an automatic purchase plan for blackout periods. Under its prior NCIB, it repurchased 1,749,691 shares at C$12.43 average price. Management views shares as undervalued and targets 40% of excess free cash flow to shareholder returns in 2026, primarily via dividends and buybacks.
